hero.title: A small, careful service — on purpose.
hero.subtitle: We built Simply the Best House-Sitters around a simple idea: your pets and your home deserve the same care you would give them yourself.

sections.heading: Our philosophy
sections.body:
We believe that consistency matters. Pets are generally most comfortable when they can remain in familiar surroundings and maintain their normal routines. The same principle applies to homes. A property that is occupied, monitored, and cared for tends to function more smoothly than one left entirely unattended.

Our role is to provide that continuity. We maintain routines, monitor the property, communicate clearly, and respond when issues arise. Everything else flows from that foundation.

sections.heading: Why in-home care
sections.body: Kennels, day-cares, and rotating drop-in visits work for some households. But many pets simply do not travel well, do not sleep alone well, or do not adjust to unfamiliar spaces. In-home overnight care removes almost all of that stress. Your pets stay where they belong, and we come to them.

sections.heading: Why property care matters
sections.body: An empty home is more than an empty home. Mail piles up, plants dry out, packages sit at the door, and small issues can become bigger ones. When we are in your home we quietly take care of all of that, so you are not returning to a to-do list.

sections.heading: Why routines matter
sections.body: Feeding times, walk times, medication times, quiet times. We follow the schedule you have already built. We do not improvise on your pets.

sections.heading: Who we work with
sections.body: We are best suited to homeowners who value professionalism, punctuality, and a service that behaves the same whether it is a two-night stay or a three-week one. If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

hero.title: Is Simply the Best right for you?
hero.subtitle: The clearest way to know is to read how we actually work. If the way we run our service matches what you're looking for, we'll be a great fit.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Simply the Best House-Sitters is a premium pet and property care service designed for clients who value professionalism, reliability, communication, and peace of mind while away from home. We are a small, boutique service based in Halifax. We take a limited number of clients so every booking gets our full attention. We are the people who will actually be in your home. Not a marketplace, not a broker.

sections.heading: Our philosophy
sections.body:
Pets are calmest in their own home, on their own schedule, with someone they have met. Homes are safer when there is a real person in them. That is what we sell. Presence, routine, and steadiness.

Our goal is simple. Provide exceptional care for your pets and home so you can enjoy your time away with complete confidence.

sections.heading: Who we serve
sections.body:
Our services are particularly well suited for destination wedding attendees, honeymoon travellers, business travellers, families on vacation, seasonal property owners, professionals with demanding schedules, and pet owners who prefer in-home care over kennels.

More broadly, we work with homeowners who value professionalism, reliability, and quiet competence over the lowest possible price. Households where the pets and the home are both worth caring for properly.

sections.heading: How booking works
sections.body: You request a quote. We confirm availability and send a written quote. We meet you and your pets in your home for a proper handover. You confirm, pay the deposit, and the dates are yours.

sections.heading: What is included
sections.body: Everything a well-run overnight stay should include. Feeding, walks, medication, waste, plants, mail, packages, garbage, and daily updates. Additional services are quoted openly.

sections.heading: Communication
sections.body:
Some clients prefer daily photo updates and detailed communication. Others prefer to disconnect completely while travelling and only be contacted in the event of an emergency. We tailor our communication style to your preferences.

By default, we send one photo and note per day, more if the situation calls for it, and a 24/7 line if anything changes. You will never wonder how your pets are doing.

sections.heading: Home requirements
sections.body:
Because overnight care is included in our service, we ask that a clean and comfortable space be available for the sitter during the stay.

This includes a private sleeping area, a clean bed with fresh linens, a comfortable mattress suitable for overnight sleeping, access to a bathroom with basic necessities, and a bedroom with an operable window.

We also ask that garbage and recycling be emptied prior to the stay, and that any food likely to spoil during an extended absence be removed or secured.

These expectations are not intended to be burdensome. They simply help ensure that our sitters can focus their attention on caring for your pets and property throughout the booking.

sections.heading: Client requirements
sections.body: A meet-and-greet in your home before the first booking. Clear written instructions for feeding, medication, and emergency vet. Pets who are safe to be around.

sections.heading: Booking policies
sections.body: A 25% deposit confirms the booking. Balance is due the day the stay begins. Full refunds up to 14 days out, partial after that. Holiday bookings should be confirmed early. We do book up.

sections.heading: Next steps
sections.body: If everything above sounds like the kind of service you would want in your home, requesting a quote is the right next step. If any of it sounds off, we would rather be honest with each other now than after a booking.

items.q: Why do you charge what you charge?
items.a: Our rate reflects overnight, in-home care. A sitter stays in your home for the full length of the booking, keeps your pets on their normal routine, and quietly looks after the property throughout. It is closer in scope to a trusted house guest than a drop-in visit, and the pricing reflects that.

items.q: Do you have a cheaper drop-in option?
items.a: Not at this time. Our whole model is built around overnight, in-home care because that is what actually keeps most pets calm.
Statutory holidays and December 22 – January 2 are billed at +25% per night. It's the only time of year our rates change.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: For summer and holiday travel, as far in advance as possible, often several months. For a random Tuesday in October, a couple of weeks is usually fine.

items.q: What happens if I need to cancel?
items.a: Full refunds up to 14 days out. Partial refunds up to 48 hours out. Cancellations closer than that are non-refundable, mostly because we have turned other bookings away to hold your dates.
Yes, before every new client's first booking. It's how we learn your pets' routines properly and how you get comfortable with us.

items.q: Do you care for cats and dogs both?
items.a: Yes. Cats, dogs, and most small mammals and birds. If you have something less common, ask us.
Yes. Oral, topical, and by-injection medications (including insulin) are all fine, with clear written instructions.

items.q: What about reactive or aggressive dogs?
items.a: We handle a lot of nervous or reactive dogs, but genuinely aggressive dogs or dogs with recent bite history are outside our scope. We'll always be honest about fit.

items.q: How often will I hear from you?
items.a: At minimum, one photo-and-note update per day. More if there's anything worth flagging. You can also reach us at any hour if you need to.

items.q: Do you send updates by text or email?
items.a: Whichever you prefer. We ask at the meet-and-greet.

items.q: What happens if my pet gets sick during a stay?
items.a: We follow the written protocol you leave with us, take your pet to your preferred vet or the nearest emergency clinic, and stay with them. You'll hear from us immediately.

items.q: What if there's a problem with the house?
items.a: Small things like a lightbulb, a rearranged rug, or an overzealous plant, we handle quietly. Anything real (a leak, a break-in, a power issue) you will hear about immediately, and we will coordinate with the trades you prefer.

items.q: When does a stay start and end?
items.a: Our standard booking runs from 12 pm on your start date to 12 pm on your end date. Your sitter arrives at noon on day one to settle in and pick up the routine, and leaves by noon on the final day. If you need earlier or later arrival or departure times, just tell us at the quote stage and we can usually accommodate.

items.q: How do I request a quote?
items.a: Use the Request a Quote form. It captures everything we need. We reply within one business day.
A 25% deposit at booking (e-transfer or credit card). Balance is due the first day of the stay.

items.q: Do you sit for households you haven't met yet on holidays?
items.a: Yes, but we strongly recommend booking the meet-and-greet well in advance for holiday dates — those weeks fill up early.
